behavior_constraints: POST /api/v1/experiments/{name}/clone creates a deep copy with new sequential run IDs continuing from global run counter; cloned maps must be independent
Cloning an experiment with 0 runs returns 'runs': [] (empty JSON array, never null)
Clone returns 404 if source missing, 409 if new_name exists, 400 if new_name empty
GET /api/v1/models/{name}/versions supports stage and min_metric=name:value filters with AND logic
Filtered versions are sorted by version number descending; empty results return 'versions': [] and count: 0
Version filtering returns 404 if model missing, 400 if min_metric format invalid
Version struct gains a Lineage field (slice of promotion records); PromoteVersion appends {from_stage, to_stage, timestamp} each call
Auto-demotion (production->staging when another version takes production) records a demotion promotion record AND sets demoted_by to the replacing version number on the demoted version
demoted_by must be omitted entirely (not 0/null) when version not demoted
GET /api/v1/models/{name}/lineage returns versions sorted ascending with promotions in chronological order; empty promotions is [] not null; returns 404 if model missing
entities.summary: This round adds experiment cloning, model version filtering, model lineage tracking, and bulk run tagging, while fixing pipeline empty-step-name validation, batch strategy echo, and serving stats zero-division safety with per-model success_rate.

instruction_head:
This round adds new capabilities and fixes issues discovered in the existing platform.

---

## New Features (Extensions)

### 1. Experiment Cloning

Add an endpoint to clone an experiment, creating a deep copy with all its runs under a new name:

- **POST /api/v1/experiments/{name}/clone** — Clone an experiment.
- Request body: `{"new_name": "experiment_v2"}`.
- Creates a new experiment with all runs from the source experiment copied over (deep copy of parameters, metrics, and tags for each run
